purpose: Compare three relatable business themes using existing SL candidates, not new model benchmarking
selection: Existing select_csv: stratified 80/20 holdout; common stratified 5-fold training-only CV, mean macro F1, candidate-order ties

bootstrap.scope: fixed fitted model, observed class counts, row-level conditional percentile

hotel.processing: Drop exact full-record duplicates; keep complete cases on selected numeric features; no reservation status/date, ADR, deposit, room assignment, changes, personal IDs or category columns as predictors
hotel.evaluation_scope: Pooled retrospective random-row holdout. Not booking-time deployment, future-period or new-hotel evaluation; unknown customer/group dependence remains
hotel.hypothesis: Longer advance bookings tend to cancel more often; repeated guests may cancel less
hotel.heuristic: predict cancellation when lead_time >= training median

coupon.processing: Drop exact raw duplicates; retain known CoffeeHouse visit-frequency responses and needed complete source columns. Use fixed codebook binary indicators; no fitted encoders or imputation
coupon.evaluation_scope: Survey response rows, not observed purchases/redemptions. No respondent ID: respondent-independent generalization unverified
coupon.hypothesis: Frequent coffee visitors and longer coupon validity tend to accept more; longer detours tend to accept less
coupon.heuristic: coffee_monthly AND ((no_urgent_destination AND NOT with_kids) OR expires_1day)

retail.cohort: Customers with at least one positive-price, positive-quantity, non-cancellation UK purchase in observation window
retail.processing: Drop exact rows, missing customer ID, invoice starting C, nonpositive price/quantity, non-UK. Gross positive sales, not net of refunds. Do not require future purchase or future presence to enter cohort. Exclude IDs and future transactions from predictors
retail.evaluation_scope: One fixed observation/outcome window and customer-disjoint random holdout. No rolling future-period validation or lifetime-value/profit claim
retail.hypothesis: More frequent and more recent buyers tend to repurchase; high past spend does not imply all will repurchase
retail.extra_heuristic: predict repurchase when monetary_gbp >= training 75th percentile

interpretation: Associations are calculated on the training sample only and do not identify causal effects. General expectations are hypotheses supported where possible by primary references; no literature score comparison across differing datasets/splits. Do not retune features, thresholds, seed or model using test results. No GPU, DL or new models. This is not an independent external validation claim.
